newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 70 bln dong T-notes, rate 7.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 70 bln dong T-notes, rate 7.9 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 70 billion dong ($6.34 million) of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 7.9 percent to domestic institutions at an auction on Wednesday, the State Bank of Vietnam said in a statement.
At the last auction of government paper, on October 2, the central bank issued 70 billion dong worth of one-year notes at a rate of eight percent.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is October 11 and maturity will be on October 11, 1997.
The bank said allotments of stock, in dong, were as follows:
Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank) 50.5 billion
Bank for Investment and Development 8.0 billion
